name: comp-433
title: Tabs With Icon Badges
description: Three icon-and-label tabs in a dark rounded bar, two carrying badge pills reading 3 and New; the active tab shifts onto a lighter block and swaps the caption below.
use: Switching between a few related views in one compact area while keeping counts visible per view.
avoid: When labels and panel text must come from data: every tab and caption is written into the file.
a11y: Tabs are real labelled controls with hidden icons, so screen readers get clean names; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A charcoal rounded strip holds three tabs, each a small line icon, a label, and where present a pale pill badge reading 3 or New. The chosen tab sits on a lighter grey rounded block, with one muted sentence centred below the bar.
behaves: Clicking a tab slides the lighter highlight onto it and replaces the caption beneath with that tab's line. Badges on inactive tabs dim to half opacity; the bar itself does not move.
customise: Tab names, icons, badge values and each panel caption are written inside; changing them means editing the file. Badge opacity and spacing are classes.
weight: light: Three tabs and a few small badges; only opacity and highlight transitions run.
